requisito: Computes the discounted order total from item prices and quantities (ignoring non-positive entries). Applies a 10% discount from 100 upward, 20% from 200 upward, and an extra +5% for VIP customers when the discount is below 20%. Returns 0 if the arrays are empty or have different lengths.

difetti.indizio: Look at the expression that computes the discount amount.
difetti.spiegazione: subtotale, percentualeSconto, and 100 are all int, so dividing by 100 truncates the fractional part of the discount before assigning to double.

difetti.indizio: Look at the conditions in the discount tier checks.
difetti.spiegazione: The check uses subtotale > 100 instead of subtotale >= 100, leaving subtotals equal to exactly 100 without the 10% discount.
